profile.headline: Software Developer in Test Consultant
profile.summary:
⚡ AI Test Automation Architect | Helping teams put autonomous agents into their delivery pipeline — with guardrails · Playwright · Claude · CI/CD

Experienced SDET and automation architect. Frameworks from scratch. Flaky suites dragged back to green. Pipelines rebuilt so teams actually trust the red light.

Now I point all of that at AI 🤖 — autonomous agents that write, review, and repair test automation in real pipelines.

🧬 Agents that read a diff, find the coverage gap, and write the tests
🐛 Agents that hunt real defects, reproduce them, and ship the fix
🔍 Agents that review code and block at file:line — and never rubber-stamp their own work
🛡️ The guardrails that keep all of it honest
💡 Most "AI in testing" is a demo. Getting an agent to write a test is easy. Catching it when it lies, loops, or claims success on work it never did — that's the real engineering. That's what I do. 🔥

🤝 Let's connect if you're wiring AI into your pipeline, wrestling a flaky suite into submission, or just want to compare AI techniques.

🔗 github.com/AnthonyL22

🛠️ Playwright · Selenium · TypeScript · Java · Claude Code (agents · skills · MCP) · GitLab CI/CD · API testing
Headline:

positions.title: Software Developer in Test
positions.description:
Senior SDET & Quality Engineering Visionary

Driving quality excellence through AI-driven automation, technical innovation, and team mentorship to scale quality engineering across enterprise systems.

• 🤖 AI-Enhanced Test Automation: Leveraging Claude AI and subagent workflows to accelerate test creation, enhance coverage, and introduce adaptive automation patterns within Playwright and API test suites.
• 🧠 AI Integration & Experimentation: Designing proof-of-concept frameworks where Claude AI assists in test generation, maintenance, and self-healing, improving efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
• ⚙️ Custom Tool Development: Architected a React-based Quality Center of Excellence platform that streamlines test suite launches, execution management, and real-time quality metrics for cross-functional teams.
• 🧩 Automation Architecture: Expanding Playwright frameworks and building advanced TypeScript-based TDD systems with modular, reusable design.
• 🚀 DevOps Integration: Implementing GitLab Release Train pipelines and automated reporting with MongoDB, TypeScript, and GitLab APIs, integrating test data seamlessly into CI/CD workflows.
• 📊 Executive Tooling: Developing custom leadership dashboards and reporting tools to surface key quality metrics, accelerating decision-making across product and engineering teams.
• 🧭 Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentoring SDETs in modern automation practices, AI-assisted test development, and continuous quality strategies that scale.
• 🌱 Team Transformation: Upskilled manual QA testers into full-stack Quality Engineers, building a culture of automation-first quality ownership throughout the organization.
• 💡 Quality Advocacy: Championing AI-driven quality engineering principles across the SDLC to ensure quality is embedded from design to delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · JavaScript · Test Automation · Node.js · TypeScript · Gitlab · Postman

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Developer in Test Automation Coach
positions.description: It is the best time in history to be an SDET.  I've launched a new automated testing coaching program for Test Engineers that want to take their careers to the next level and beyond.  So excited to be coaching my current group of some of the brightest, most eager test engineers in San Diego.  Thanks team!

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
• Responsible for the successful development of web-based products and services such as BCI mind control software products, mobile device web service implementations and e-Commerce website solutions.
• Manage and lead the requirements gathering, business design and technical implementation of a multitude of products and
services.
• Design and implement interactive web sites and tools for web tracking, analysis, and configuration.

positions.title: Guest Lecturer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Thanks to Professor Steve Wade and his incredible class of future automated test engineers for allowing me to teach and share in everything AUTOMATION.  This is absolutely the best time in history to be an SDET.  I can't wait for next semester!

positions.title: Analysis Programmer, Sr
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the development of open-source automated testing microservices, streamlining execution and improving scalability.
- Designed and deployed a Selenium-based concurrent automation framework, reducing cross-browser/platform/device execution from hours to under 15 minutes.
- Built and optimized CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins for AWS-hosted microservices, accelerating release cycles and ensuring reliability.
- Implemented enterprise-wide Sauce Labs integration, delivering automated testing solutions for Qualcomm’s Patent, Intellectual Property, and Legal divisions.
- Automated complex application layers across 20+ business teams, including:
  Web applications (Angular, Aurelia, Sencha)
  Mobile web applications
  Spring Boot REST and SOAP services
  Oracle, MySQL, and SQL Server databases
- Mentored and guided global test engineering teams (onshore & offshore), elevating technical expertise and promoting best practices in test automation.
- Championed efficiency and quality initiatives that shortened regression cycles, increased coverage, and enabled faster go-to-market delivery across Qualcomm IT.
positions.insights: Skills: TestNG · Java · Maven · Selenium WebDriver · Jenkins

positions.title: Quality Engineering Lead at Royal Caribbean
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Quality Engineering lead for Royal Caribbean Digital Commerce web & microservice API teams.  One of my passions at Royal Caribbean is steering our QE teams towards innovative solutions to solve classic SDET challenges as well as developing creative DevOps Jenkins pipelines.

• Web Application QE responsible for T.D.D. of Angular application leveraging Selenium, TestNG, digital.ai (Experitest), Browsermob, Cypress & many hand-rolled testing solutions
• Service Team QE leveraging Postman, JMeter, Newman & Jenkins for full e2e Spring web service functional and performance automation solutions
• Building Jenkins pipelines for complete CI/CD delivery of application code from merged PRs automatically to Production deployments in Canary Akamai web environments
• Responsible for building and monitoring ThousandEyes global synthetic monitoring solutions for both web and service teams to ensure high-availability of our systems on 4 continents every 2 minutes
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Selenium · Jenkins · Postman · JMeter

positions.title: Test Automation Architect
positions.description:
• Designed & Developed a highly scalable as well as distributed automated testing framework built in Java, Selenium, HtmlUnit, TestNG, Ruby, and Scala
• Used to automate our fleet management SaaS solution's:
 - Web Application
 - REST and SOAP Web Services
 - Database layer
 - Embedded Device
 - Mobile Solution
 - Performance Initiatives
• Designing Selenium GRID networks and custom Selenium optimizations for high capacity distributed automated testing

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Successfully designed and developed highly customized Java & Selenium functional automated testing frameworks for Qualcomm's Flex-based fleet management software solutions
• Led both onshore & offshore automation test teams for QES software division
• Mentored junior Java developers to ultimately become expert level Automation Engineers
• Responsible for developing various Java tools and infrastructure frameworks to support QES development groups
• Developed performance script solutions and harnesses leveraging HP LoadRunner for Java, Flex, REST, Ext-JS, and SQL Server integrated systems
• Implemented Maven and Hudson build architecture for companies Java and also Adobe Flex applications

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•  Responsible for designing and developing Surfrider's 'BeachMap' web application, which is a Google Map / PHP / MySql based wiki-type application that enables users to add, find, and get information on beaches worldwide.
• Converted BeachMap application to a Google Mapplet

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Successfully designed and implemented company’s Java-based automated testing solution for a J2EE patient safety web application designed to prevent clinical medical errors in over 50 hospitals nationwide.  
•	As an active member of an agile, Extreme Programming (XP) development environment, I implemented HtmlUnit to completely automate every feature and defect within the company’s web application(s).
•	Led company’s efforts in implementing HtmlUnit and foundational Extreme Programming methodologies within several internal software development groups.
•	Currently saving company over twelve man-weeks of regression test-cycle time due to complete feature and defect automation coverage.  Responsible for successfully releasing defect-free builds on a daily basis, thus enabling the company to release it’s first Beta release on-time and feature complete

positions.title: Consultant - Architect Team
positions.description:
•  Implemented HtmlUnit automation technology for automating companies new MoneyCenter banking Java web application
•  Responsible for developing Java API to third-party HtmlUnit base classes, thus offering the ability to automate the companies application
•  Trained offshore Java development team coding standards, methodologies, tools and HtmlUnit technologies

positions.title: Senior Automation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for developing enterprise level web application software built in Java that delivers DHTML to a thin client portal running on MSSQL, Oracle 8i and 9i databases
•	Led and implemented complete functional automated test solution developed in advanced SQABasic and Visual Basic for E-Learning web applications built in Java, DHTML, and PowerBuilder technologies
•	Developed entire performance script repository using Mercury VUGenerator 7.51 and LoadRunner 7.51 to load-test company’s Java-based web application 
•	Reduced the build verification and regression test cycle duration for a three person test team from three weeks to ten days

positions.title: Consultant - Automation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Resolved offshore team’s automation script development roadblocks using Rational TeamTest features, advanced SQABasic, and Visual Basic scripting techniques
•	Designed customized automated test scripts and library files utilizing Rational Robot 2002.05
•	Educated test engineering group on all Rational TeamTest 2002 topics

positions.title: Senior Automation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Utilized Rational Robot to completely automate front-end, database and business-object application layers of an online accounting application
•	Responsible for developing and executing all automated performance test scripts for application optimization using Rational Robot
•	Developed a streamlined approach to the automation test development process, by developing a customized Visual Basic automation code generator. Successfully designed key-word based automated script templates and related technologies which allowed users to develop automated scripts in simple MS Word documents
•	Taught advanced Rational Robot scripting classes to both the domestic and offshore Test Engineering groups

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed complete functional and performance automated test repositories using the SQABasic scripting language and Rational Test Suite 7.1 for a PowerBuilder-based debt management software solution.
•	Project lead for load test analysis project resulting in $1.5 million contract with a major banking conglomerate

educations.fieldOfStudy: Java I – Java IV (Advanced Java Application Design)

courses.name: The Ultimate Typescript Course (Code with Mosh)

honors.title: Product Development Recognition Award
honors.description: Cool award I got at Royal Caribbean for "The Ninja".  Nice to get recognized for working hard and helping others.  Thanks Royal!  Attached PDF above describing what this means.

projects.title: Automated Testing Microservices
projects.description: Automated testing microservices used to the perform functional system tests on any desktop or mobile browser, REST service and database endpoints.  Actively supporting 6 automated testing microservices based in Java and using Selenium that are available for use as well as guest lecturing/teaching these projects at University of California San Diego.
